title: The Light House | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Gorgeous home with fabulous amenities and porches* 5 Bedrooms including 2 Masters and a Bunkroom* 4 Complimentary Bicycles* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1 mile (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Gorgeous home with fabulous amenities and porches* 5 Bedrooms including 2 Masters and a Bunkroom* 4 Complimentary Bicycles* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1 mile (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* 9/10th of a mile from Redfish Village; near Blue Mountain Beach, and Gulf Place* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* The Light House is a gorgeous home in the Highland Parks community, with a large community resort-style pool, and near the always popular Blue Mountain Ice Cream shop! The neighborhood has a quiet, secluded feeling, yet you can bike to the beach and several restaurants. Enjoy the amazing pool with whirlpool, 360-observation tower, grilling area, and fire-pit with comfy chairs and couches, where you can sit, chat and enjoy your favorite drink with your family and friends. There is a large covered open air gathering area where you can cook and grill by the pool. Walk from The Light House to the pool area along the nature trail located just outside the back door of the home. From the 4 story observation tower you can see the gulf, the bay, and miles along the coast to Seaside and Sandestin in either direction.The main floor has a large dining table (seats 6 and expands), 4 bar stools at the counter, and open, bright, and airy living room. The gourmet kitchen has everything you will need to make delicious meals for your family! There is a large pantry to put your groceries away. You will find a large 55” flat screen TV in the downstairs den. The large master bedroom on the first floor has a king bed and a 40' flat screen TV. The master bath has a beautiful travertine tile, walk in shower, plus high granite counter tops. There is a private back deck off the downstairs master bedroom facing the wooded trail leading to the pool. This back deck is a wonderful spot to enjoy your morning coffee in a quiet, natural setting.The second floor has a large 2nd master bedroom, with king bed with a Flatscreen TV. The beautiful large master bathroom has a walk in travertine shower and plenty of storage in a large walk in closet. There are two large, second floor queen bedrooms. Each bedroom is whimsically named and labeled by a painted starfish hanging on the door. There is 5th bedroom on the second floor with two twin bunk beds that sleeps four. In the upstairs hallways are two full bathrooms with soaking tubs and showers. A utility room with full-sized washer and dryer is located just off the kitchen next to a half bath.There is a lighted walkway from the back of the property that leads directly to the pool area. There are 2 grills located under the awning in the pool area, along with a large flat screen TV, couches, tables and chairs. Perfect for a cool down! Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Park is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.Bed Setup:First Floor: Master w/KingSecond Floor: Master w/KingSecond Floor: Guest room w/QueenSecond Floor: Guest room w/QueenSecond Floor: Bunkroom with 2 Twin Bunkbeds (Sleeps 4)*Parking only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*AREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike rentals are available and within walking distance at Big Daddy's Bike Shop (2217 W. Co Hwy 30A) for you to take a ride along scenic 30A.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
